independence: Wingless-only. No Yggdrasil evidence, manifests, thresholds, representations, outcomes, or successor decisions may be consumed.
hypothesis: The negative R45 result reflects inadequate causal learning-state formation rather than readout capacity. Replacing instantaneous state formation with one fixed six-dimensional causal recurrent state update, while preserving the same seven-parameter linear readout and fixed allocation budget, will improve pairwise action choice on three fresh disjoint manifests.
competing_explanation: Any apparent improvement is due to action identity or historical mean value rather than the frozen causal recurrent formation state.
historical_fit_partition: Exact R45 historical transfer/third/fourth/fifth manifests only. Fresh twelfth/thirteenth/fourteenth outcomes may not enter state formation design, fitting, pair selection, thresholds, or controls.

state_formation.name: causal_recurrent_formation_6
state_formation.rule: For each six-dimensional base state x_k at budget step k, form s_0=0 and s_k=(s_{k-1}+x_k)/2 componentwise. The readout consumes only s_k. The recurrence coefficient is fixed at 1/2 before any R46 outcome and is not swept or tuned.

candidate_actions: Exact R27 fixed-total candidate set; evaluate all 36 unordered pairs among the nine non-equal allocations with lexicographic pair order frozen before fresh outcomes.
treatment: Fit the same seven-parameter ridge-linear marginal-hit readout on the six recurrent-formation state components using only the four historical manifests. Freeze all fresh action scores and pair choices before revealing realized hits.

controls.base6_same_capacity: Same seven-parameter ridge-linear readout on the existing six instantaneous R27/base-six state using the identical historical partition.
controls.action_only: Historical mean realized value for each allocation using the identical historical partition.

classification_rules.supported: valid; >=72 non-tie pairs; formation accuracy exceeds base6 by >=0.05; formation beats base6 on at least two of three fresh manifests; and formation mean regret <=0.90*base6 mean regret
classification_rules.mixed: valid; support false; formation accuracy exceeds base6 by >=0.015; formation beats base6 on at least two of three fresh manifests; and formation mean regret is lower than base6
classification_rules.negative: valid and neither supported nor mixed
classification_rules.invalid: any exact source/blob/prefix, historical partition, candidate action/pair order, fixed budget, six-dimensional recurrent formation, seven-parameter readout, heldout ordering, deterministic replay, provenance, or accounting rule fails

negative_interpretation: Stop deterministic hand-designed state-formation transforms over this representation and escalate to a learned/raw-input formation mechanism under the same fixed resource envelope.
infra_failure_policy: Exact infrastructure repair and deterministic rerun only. Scientific negative/mixed outcomes remain immutable evidence.
